status: DESIGN ONLY; no authorization to read proposed data
label_formula: entry=next bar open; exit=close of horizon-th subsequent bar; gross=(exit/entry-1); LONG/SHORT if beyond max(cost,volatility_multiple*causal_sigma20*sqrt(horizon)); else FLAT

training_calibration.model_updates: none; frozen January-2022 weights, temperature and training priors; no refit or recalibration

proposed_period.justification: next three chronological months after development, spanning a DST change; limits age of the frozen model; proposal only
proposed_period.access: PROHIBITED until later explicit user authorization
proposed_period.untouched_status: UNVERIFIED; audit prior research/access records before authorization; if previously examined, preregister a replacement without viewing outcomes

freeze_rules: one selected candidate; no model family/feature/target/threshold changes
one scheduled evaluation after evidence requirements are met; no rolling peeks or optional stopping
hash and timestamp protocol before later authorization and any data access
no choosing another candidate after seeing confirmation; amendments create a new exploratory study
all failed or blocked runs preserved; no selective reporting
benchmarks: causal return_5 momentum and mean reversion
secondary_metrics: 0.55 gated signal frequency and net hypothetical movement

uncertainty.method: paired circular UTC-day block bootstrap, preserving all intraday overlaps
uncertainty.multiplicity: joint success across BOTH metrics and BOTH primary benchmarks at BOTH block lengths; one preregistered candidate, no post-hoc subset selection; exploratory G uncertainty is not confirmation

minimum_evidence.insufficient_counts: INCONCLUSIVE, never lower confidence threshold or extend range automatically

acceptance.predictive: All primary paired 95% CIs: candidate-minus-benchmark log-loss upper<0 AND balanced-accuracy lower>0 at both block lengths; data/calendar/replay gates all pass
acceptance.economic: separate from predictive acceptance: sufficient 0.55 signal evidence, validated bid/ask and execution/calendar assumptions, and dependence-aware net movement lower CI>0 under base and 3.1bps stress; no profitability claim from classification
acceptance.rejection: FAIL predictive if dependence-aware CI shows worse loss AND no accuracy advantage against both benchmarks; FAIL economics if sufficient evidence and net upper CI<=0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
acceptance.no_signals: economic advantage unestablished; never manufacture trades

data_quality: verified broker/account/instrument historical session and holiday schedule including DST
UTC timestamp lineage and price-side semantics established
strict minute alignment, monotonicity and sealed partition checksums
no fill of missing candles; no labels across gaps/unverified boundaries
record exclusions before metrics; identical eligible timestamps across comparators
checkpoint_replay: source/protocol/model/code/environment hashes bound in immutable atomic journal
hard-crash before commit; immutable prefix and repeat-resume checks
independent uninterrupted replay, every committed file and canonical-state hash identical
independent event metric and label verifier
resource_profile: separate explicitly authorized profile required for new dates; current 1.20 profile remains Jan-Feb only
restrictions: no new historical access in STRAT-2H
decision_if_H_disappointing: protocol remains frozen; recommend further causal research or defer confirmation; no automatic execution
